facts.text: Florencia Solange's public Kaggle profile shows an account that joined in August 2026, with the one-line bio "Quietly working away".
Her Kaggle Competitions tab lists a single competition, the active ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-3, entered as part of a team. It shows no completed competitions and no medals.

On the ARC-3 public board she is listed with the team Grigoriy Zatravkin & co, which stood 9th of 4,984 teams when last read. That is a provisional team standing, not a medal and not an individual result.
